articles.factsToPreserve: AgentCore Gateway: bedrock-runtime connector supports InvokeModel and InvokeModelWithResponseStream. matchModels routes by exact or wildcard model name; model override and ordered fallback keep compatible request formats. Test us-east-1, Python3.14, boto3 1.43.115 with1.43.118 API model overlay; Lambda emulates normal/503/10sec slow primary, Mantle gpt-oss-120b secondary; Haiku4.5 invokes and streams through Runtime. 3sec first-byte threshold; 20 sequential requests total93.5sec without breaker and70.1sec with, primary calls20 vs12. Single authored comparison, not a general latency or availability promise; opening threshold not configurable or documented. Once streaming starts fallback does not resume it. Gateway429 or Policy403 does not trigger fallback; retry costs per attempt, response lacks route identity so use logs. Console Runtime connector not yet shown to author; Converse returns400 in this test. No cloud resources created or paid APIs invoked in this authoring run.

articles.factsToPreserve: Learning webapp keepsXP,answerhistory,reviewplans in localStorage. Snapshot rawJSON is compared before save; revision/writer/time metadata alone gives no atomic CAS. Cooperative exclusive WebLock wraps reread/compare/write under same origin. storage event notifies other tabs, not writer, and is not lock. Conflict pauses answers/autosave; diagnosticJSON export keeps in-memory expected/current values; reload saved latest separate. No automatic merge ofrewards/histories, no multi-keytransaction, unsupported WebLocks best effort only. Tests use simulated locks/sourcechecks; real simultaneous2tab E2E andAndroid/Brave untested; article didnot run freshCI.
